title: Versioned multi-claim extraction and review

files.change: Production extraction contract derived from contracts.json; strict structured types and provenance.
Bounded candidate extraction; optional configured LLM structured-output adapter, no automatic trusted status.
Validate dates, quotes/locators, entity scope, units, source rights and schema.
Explicit publish/reject/dispute/resolve operations with append-only audit.
Separate event-kind dates and product/company anchors; reuse tested parsing only.
Feed shared candidate pipeline; prevent legacy writer bypass.

steps: Extract all relevant atomic facts from each document with track tags; never force one strategic event per article.
Save parser/model/prompt/schema versions, per-run budget and raw candidate response under controlled access.
Resolve relative dates against evidenced document date only; retain original temporal phrase. Multiple incompatible claims form conflicts.
Store source-attributed intent, reported result and analyst hypothesis as different types. Exact excerpt match plus evidence review required; schema-valid output alone is insufficient.
Run deterministic extraction for structured sources; LLM for narrative candidates only. Provider/model configured, not hard-coded or purchased.
tests: A multi-topic release yields independently cited pricing, availability and distribution claims.
Reject fabricated quotations, wrong page, ambiguous dates, unsupported product assignment and prompt-injection instructions.
Replay with older/newer extractor does not erase review holds; explicit resolution retains alternatives.
completion_evidence: zero uncited published factual claims in golden fixtures
